basic_info.description: 785 Bay Street is a charming 3 story, 6 unit, wood frame building, built in 1954. The building is comprised of 6 large one bedroom apartments and 3-  car garage parking. The units have gas wall heaters with electrical service supported by individual circuit breaker panels. Each unit is arranged with a great-room design and open-air kitchen floorplan. The kitchens and baths have been remodeled with hardwood floors throughout. These stylish and functional apartment homes have tons of natural light and the upstairs units have Bay and Bridge views.
